scientific_role: method-independent localization of each frozen global admissibility region A_G into provider-local A_i values before public I1 cards are materialized
principle: A_i is part of the instantiated I1 card. Therefore A_G to A_i localization belongs to Phase 2 and is frozen before M0 or M1 consumes I1.

localization_rule.latency: For every provider i: L_i_max = L_G_max - L_common - L_branch_i, because global latency is L_common + max_i(L_branch_i + L_i).
localization_rule.cost: For every provider i: C_i_max = (C_G_max - C_fixed)/3. The residual global additive cost budget is split equally as a method-independent benchmark convention.
localization_rule.quality: For every provider i: Q_i_min = Q_G_min, because global quality is the minimum over quality-neutral fixed stages and providers.

rho_policy.reason: Each I1 card exposes the full frozen rho support R. A composition method may choose which rho slice or slices to consume without changing I1.

phase_boundary: Phase 2 is complete only after the exact A_i query declaration is frozen, the public I1 cards are materialized from the frozen provider corpus, and the resulting card set is frozen for identical use by M0 and M1.
